subtitle: Lesson 87 · Syntax, identity, case folding, and datatypes

eyebrow: IDENTITY vs. SERIAL vs. GENERATED AS IDENTITY
caption: GENERATED AS IDENTITY is the modern, SQL-standard choice.

code:
CREATE TABLE Orders (...);
-- Actually creates: orders (lowercase)

SELECT * FROM Orders;   -- works, folds to orders

CREATE TABLE "Orders" (...);
-- Creates a table literally named Orders

SELECT * FROM Orders;   -- FAILS — folds to orders,
                         -- which doesn't exist
caption: PostgreSQL folds unquoted names to lowercase — opposite of SQL Server.
